title: Skill SKILL.md frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter at the top of every plugins/nextjs-clean-skills/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md file. Claude Code truncates the combined description and when_to_use text past 1,536 characters, so the description must stay rich enough for reliable routing. Properties cover the documented Claude Code fields plus the Agent Skills metadata block, so adopting a field is no longer a schema change. additionalProperties stays false to catch typos, which is the only thing it should catch.

name.description: Agent Skills spec: 1-64 chars, lowercase alphanumerics and hyphens, no leading, trailing or consecutive hyphen — the pattern enforces all three. validate-skill-frontmatter.mjs separately asserts the value equals the skill directory name, so the set is deliberately not enumerated here: an enum made every rename a schema edit, and one such edit is how the rename in PR #16 shipped half-done. The reserved-word guard is Anthropic's Skills API rule rather than the open spec; it costs nothing here and stops a future skill from being rejected at upload time.

description.description: Agent Skills spec caps this at 1024. validate-skill-frontmatter.mjs applies a stricter 500-char repo convention on top, and checks description + when_to_use against Claude Code's 1,536-char listing cap.

stringOrList.description: Space- or comma-separated string, or a YAML list.

looseBoolean.description: Claude Code 2.1.218+ accepts yes/no/on/off/1/0 in any letter case alongside true/false. The integer branch is load-bearing: YAML parses an unquoted 1 or 0 as a number, so a string-only branch rejected the very values this field documents.
